sources.critical_coverage: Instruction's five named functional domains; at least one substantive item per domain
sources.independent_controls: Skill controlled-variable/competing-cause method; D04 route, D07 clock-origin and D10 measurement-object conflation
sources.no_fabricated_execution: Instruction no invented results and skill proposed-tests/results separation

severity.independent_controls: high affirmative conflation; ordinary omission remains continuous only

normalizations: Unicode NFKC; lowercase; whitespace and dash normalization
Lossless domain synonyms: log/logged/logging -> record; ascertain -> confirm; cursor -> pointer; trial/trials -> attempts
Equivalent English headers bind semantic roles
Positive predicates bind operative case content; titles and IDs are non-authoritative
Declared common execution/configuration rules and source-entity qualifications are workbook-scoped; named setup IDs and sheet!cell references retain original locators without executing formulas
Quoted, proposed and rejected actions are excluded; adopted negative safety/measurement constraints remain authoritative; deductions require an affirmative proposition within one sentence
Fixed all-N populations are valid denominators; directed metric arithmetic is checked by bounded exact symbolic rational algebra; an explicitly unused WER is conditionally inapplicable
